Yeast replicative lifespan differs from animal survival. Yeast TOR1 pairs are non-1:1; TOR and S6K share a pathway.
* Mouse benefit is female-specific; male increase was not significant. The 2011 correction concerns a worm strain,
not mouse survival. No worm–mouse pair is implied.
* Original female Igf1r benefit; male increase not significant. † Not reproduced in a later cohort (PMID 22132081).
Insr is a separate paralog; no fly–mouse pair is implied.
Y/W/F/M identify genes in yeast/worm/fly/mouse columns. Pair codes retain the OMA source orientation.
Refs are catalogue-linked PMIDs, not newly reviewed experiments. Empty cells do not establish biological absence.
GenAge lifespan labels do not specify interventions. Only reviewed examples have experiment arrows and colours.
